ceu: ✦ The trine between Venus and Jupiter

s.k: A day to create, play and feel.
t: A day to shine without fear. What you do with passion is contagious to those around you.

The trine between Venus and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, your career and routine: Venus brings affection and harmony, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. It is a good moment to bring the two together in a single plan.
s.d: Plan a romantic moment, even a simple one.

s.k: Look after your nest and the people in it.
t: The Moon passes through your area of home and family. It is a day to be close to those who give you roots.

The trine between Venus and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, your horizons and romance: Venus brings affection and harmony, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Use this good energy to sort out what had stalled.
s.d: Make your bedroom a place of rest: less clutter, more peace.

s.k: The right words open doors today.
t: Today your mind is quicker and more curious. Use it to settle pending matters in writing or in person.

The trine between Venus and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, intimacy and family: Venus brings affection and harmony, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Doors open more easily when you ask clearly.
s.d: Write an idea down on paper before it slips away.

s.k: Security is built in small steps.
t: With the Moon in your house of values, you crave comfort and concrete things. Choose with your head before you spend.

The trine between Venus and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, relationships and conversations: Venus brings affection and harmony, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. An idea from today could become a real project.
s.d: Make a list of what you have already achieved and give thanks.

t: Today the Moon visits your sign and puts your energy in the spotlight. People notice you more, so show your best side.

The trine between Venus and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, routine and money: Venus brings affection and harmony, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Trust what you are building: today the sky lends a hand.
s.d: Look at yourself in the mirror with the tenderness you show the people you love.

t: A day for prayer, meditation or a simple walk on your own. The peace you find today stays with you.

The trine between Venus and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, romance and your image: Venus brings affection and harmony, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Smile more: kindness opens paths today.
s.d: Sleep a little longer, if you can.

s.k: The future takes shape in good company.
t: The Moon passes through your area of friends and projects. Good company gives you energy today.

The trine between Venus and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, family and your inner life: Venus brings affection and harmony, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. A small gesture can have a big effect today.
s.d: Do a friend a favour without expecting anything in return.

s.k: Think of the summit, climb one step.
t: Today work and reputation carry emotional weight. Praise or criticism touches you more than usual.

The trine between Venus and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, conversations and friendships: Venus brings affection and harmony, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Be thankful for what goes well and say it out loud.
s.d: Say no to a task that is not yours.

t: With the Moon in your house of wisdom, the day asks for meaning: ask yourself where you want to go, not just how.

The trine between Venus and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, money and your career: Venus brings affection and harmony, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Let things flow without forcing them.
s.d: Accept an invitation that is different from usual.

s.k: Let go of what no longer belongs to you.
t: The Moon touches intimacy and strong bonds. Open up to those who deserve it, and only to those who deserve it.

The trine between Venus and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, your image and your horizons: Venus brings affection and harmony, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Put your heart and your head on the same side.
s.d: Speak frankly about a matter you keep avoiding.

s.k: A day to get in step as a pair.
t: A good day for agreements and serious conversations with those who walk beside you. Be clear and fair.

The trine between Venus and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, your inner life and intimacy: Venus brings affection and harmony, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. It is a day for sowing: what you do today grows over time.
s.d: Give way on something small to gain on something big.

t: The Moon passes through your area of routine and health. Organising the day is the best way to make the most of it.

The trine between Venus and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, friendships and relationships: Venus brings affection and harmony, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Use it to take a step you keep putting off.
s.d: Book that test or check-up you keep putting off.
